summary: CIBC filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated August 20, 2026, announcing the appointment of Prasanna Gopalakrishnan to its Board of Directors effective September 1, 2026. No special-situation transaction is involved: no stake, price per share, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed. The appointment is a routine board succession matter, not a forced or abrupt CEO/CFO departure. The filing contains only the press release and a signature page, so there is no deal term or risk-arb angle to monitor beyond ordinary governance and disclosure matters.
